Pipeline A turns **PSA** PSGC Excel/PDF snapshots into W3C ORG RDF linked data, and computes a
per-snapshot change-history delta. Its end product is the `delta.{ttl,nt,jsonld}` files that live
under each `YYYY-MM-DD/` snapshot directory — see the [Change history (RDF)](../rdf/index.qmd)
section for consuming them.

## Flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  src["PSGC XLSX snapshots<br/>(~/commons/barangay/YYYY-MM-DD/)"]
  scanner["ingest/scanner.py<br/>classify files by regex"]
  xlsx["ingest/xlsx_parser.py<br/>PSGC sheet + changes; ~50 → 10 canonical change types"]
  pdf["ingest/pdf_parser.py<br/>OCR text from press-release PDFs"]
  agent["agent/pipeline.py<br/>(optional) LLM batch extraction"]
  builder["rdf/builder.py<br/>ORG ontology graph"]
  delta["rdf/delta.py<br/>compute_delta()"]
  out[("YYYY-MM-DD/<br/>delta.{ttl,nt,jsonld}")]

  src --> scanner --> xlsx --> pdf
  pdf -.optional.-> agent --> builder
  xlsx --> builder
  builder --> delta --> out
```

## Stages

- **`ingest/scanner.py`** — classifies snapshot files by regex (datafile, changes, press release,
  province summary).

- **`ingest/xlsx_parser.py`** — parses the PSGC sheet (entities) + changes sheets; normalizes ~50
  raw change types to 10 canonical ones.

- **`ingest/pdf_parser.py`** — OCR text from PDF press releases (kreuzberg).
- **`agent/pipeline.py`** *(optional)* — LLM batch extraction (structured JSON output, batches of
  50 entities / 100 changes). See [configuration](configuration.qmd) for the required env vars.

- **`rdf/builder.py`** — builds the RDF graph on the ORG ontology.
- **`rdf/delta.py`** — `compute_delta()` between two snapshots.

## Detected change-event types

`compute_delta()` detects: `creation`, `deletion`, `code_change`, `rename`, `merger`, `split`,
`name_correction`, `transfer`. See [RDF event types](../rdf/event-types.qmd) and the
[PSGC code structure](../references/psgc.qmd) reference (9-digit correspondence codes drive identity
tracking across code changes).

## Running it

```bash
brgybnd ingest --date 2023-10-24
brgybnd process --date 2023-10-24 --format turtle
```

See the [CLI reference](cli.qmd) for all flags.
